Generated Narrative: CodeSystem nmdp-specimen-type

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.nmdp.org/codesystem/specimen-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
blood-acd Blood (ACD)Whole blood collected in an ACD (Acid Citrate Dextrose) anticoagulant tube.
blood-edta Blood (EDTA)Whole blood collected in an EDTA anticoagulant tube.
blood-no-anticoagulant Blood (No Anticoagulant)Whole blood collected without anticoagulant.
blood-sodium-heparin Blood (Sodium Heparin)Whole blood collected in a sodium heparin anticoagulant tube.
buccal-swab Buccal SwabBuccal epithelial cells collected via oral swab.
hair-root Hair RootHair follicle root sample for DNA extraction.
saliva SalivaSaliva sample for DNA extraction.

name: NMDPSpecimenTypeCS
title: NMDP Specimen Type Code System
description: Codes identifying the type of specimen collected from a donor for HLA typing or infectious disease marker testing.
